description: This source file provides utility functions to resolve and construct the command line invocation for npm from a specified Node.js environment, compatible with different platforms (Windows and POSIX). It handles locating npm CLI scripts/executables, and creating commands to run npm programs, considering platform-specific differences and environment variable configurations.

methods.name: resolvePathEnvKey
methods.description: Finds the environment variable key for 'PATH', case-insensitive, defaulting to 'PATH'.

methods.name: escapeForCmdExe
methods.description: Escapes a command line argument for Windows cmd.exe, checking for unsafe characters and quoting if necessary.

methods.name: buildCmdExeCommandLine
methods.description: Constructs a Windows command line string from a command and its arguments, escaping each argument properly.

methods.name: resolveToolchainNpmRunner
methods.description: Attempts to locate the npm CLI script or executable within the Node.js installation directory, returning command and args for execution based on platform.
